components.name: Primary Consultation Button
components.description: Primary call-to-action button for consultations and urgent leads.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #A45138; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: var(--font-manrope, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #A45138; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(164,81,56,0.2); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #893E28; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(164,81,56,0.3); }

components.name: Studio Charcoal Action Button
components.description: Bold editorial button for main navigation and primary surface interactions.

components.name: Architectural Input Field
components.description: Standard form input for booking and design brief workflows.
components.html: <input type="text" class="ds-input-field" placeholder="e.g. Gulshan 2, Apartment (3,200 sqft)" />

narrative.overview: Bangla Sketch's visual system evokes the quiet luxury of a master architect's atelier in Dhaka. It rejects sterile, clinical minimalism and synthetic neon palettes in favor of organic tactile warmth: hand-laid limestone, sunlit ivory plaster, natural earthen terracotta clay, and weathered studio olive. The atmosphere is calm, contemplative, and editorial—treating every home interior as a work of fine art and enduring physical craftsmanship.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial Typographic Harmony (Instrument Serif & Manrope + Noto Serif/Sans Bengali)
Hairline Architectural Precision (1px structural framing over noisy shadows)

rules.name: The Rarity of Clay Rule
rules.body: Burnt Clay (#A45138) is reserved exclusively for primary calls to action, saved counts, and active focus points. It should occupy <=5% of visual screen surface to maintain its urgent, premium pull.

rules.name: The Organic Paper Rule
rules.body: Never use pure digital white (#FFFFFF) for background expanses on the public website. Always use Warm Ivory (#FAF7F2 / #F4F0E8) to preserve tactile organic warmth.

rules.name: The Typographic Balance Rule
rules.body: All headlines must have text-wrap: balance and body paragraphs text-wrap: pretty to ensure zero orphaned words across responsive viewport widths.

rules.name: The Bilingual Parity Rule
rules.body: When rendering Bengali text, line heights expand automatically (line-height: 1.8 for body, 1.45 for headings) to accommodate conjunct character ascenders and descenders without clipping.

rules.name: The Hairline Framing Rule
rules.body: Every elevated container must pair its elevation with a subtle 1px border (border: 1px solid var(--color-limestone)), ensuring crisp edge definition even in high-glare lighting environments.

dos: Do use var(--color-ivory-light) (#FAF7F2) and var(--color-ivory) (#F4F0E8) for page and container backgrounds.
Do pair Instrument Serif / Noto Serif Bengali for headlines with Manrope / Noto Sans Bengali for body copy.
Do wrap headlines in text-wrap: balance and body copy in text-wrap: pretty.
Do keep interactive hover transitions between 180ms and 220ms with custom cubic-bezier easing (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)).
Do provide explicit touch targets of at least 44px height for all mobile interactive controls.
donts: Don't use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) as large surface backgrounds.
Don't use aggressive, saturated neon colors or generic cold grays (#6B7280).
Don't use heavy, blurry drop shadows without a bounding 1px architectural hairline border.
Don't crowd headlines—always ensure generous top and bottom breathing room (minimum 3rem padding).
Don't disable focus indicators—always preserve the 2px Studio Olive outline with 3px offset for keyboard accessibility.
